subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Marketplace close playbook & reseller steps
body:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@resellera.io>; Tom Wu <tom.wu@acme-tech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Marketplace close playbook & reseller steps

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Quick weekly checkpoint from our side on the MAP and next steps for the marketplace purchase path. Goal: get the reseller contract + marketplace listing completed and paperwork sent to procurement by EOW (next Friday). High-level status below, then proposed owners and action items.

Status highlights:
- MAP v3 (attached) includes updated billing flow for AWS and Azure marketplace listings.
- Reseller ID confirmation pending from Resellera for Azure (Alicia — can you confirm the reseller GUID this week?).
- Procurement at Acme indicated they need a merchant-of-record option for GCP if we go through a partner.

Attachments: acme_map_v3.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)
Related: aws_marketplace_steps.pdf (PDF, implementation checklist)

Proposed next steps / owners: (short)
- Resellera to confirm reseller GUID for Azure — owner: Alicia — due 2027-04-20
- Redwood to prepare DocuSign with standard SOW + marketplace exhibit — owner: Karthik — due 2027-04-21
- Acme procurement to confirm MRR/merchant preference for GCP — owner: Tom/Procurement — due 2027-04-22
- Tech kickoff (1 hr) to review billing routing and reconciliation for AWS — owner: Marissa — schedule for week of 4/26

Please reply with any changes to owners or timelines and attach any PO templates.

Thanks,
Dylan
--
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Lead, US West
Redwood Inference

----

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@resellera.io>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@acme-tech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Marketplace close playbook & reseller steps

Thanks Dylan — quick answers below.

- Reseller GUID for Azure: RSR-987654 (confirmed). Attaching reseller onboarding packet and our preferred merchant integration flow.
- We can support merchant-of-record for GCP but need to confirm tax/invoicing details (I will loop in our finance ops).

Attachments: resellera_onboarding_packet.pdf (PDF)

I can join a 30–60 min tech call to walk through billing routing. Tentative windows: 4/26 or 4/27 afternoon PT.

Alicia
Customer Success, Resellera

----

On Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 09:30 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks — scheduling update: I booked a provisional slot for the tech kickoff 4/26 2:00–3:00 PM PT. Invite to follow after Tom confirms procurement availability.
> 
> Quick note on AWS Marketplace steps: our ops team flagged a need to map SKU-level reconciliation to Acme's billing codes; Karthik, can you add a short appendix to the MAP that lists the SKU mapping format?
> 
> -Marissa

----

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia@resellera.io>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@acme-tech.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Marketplace close playbook & reseller steps

Sharing the purchase-path packet and the draft DocuSign envelope. I incorporated reseller GUID and added an appendix for SKU mapping (see acme_map_v3.xlsx).

Key procurement items I submitted to legal for fast review:
- Standard SOW + marketplace exhibit (no change to liability clauses).
- One requested redline from Acme procurement: liability cap uplift from $500k to $1M — legal flagged this as needing approval; want to surface to leadership if they push back.

DocuSign link (draft, not sent): https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123
Attachments: aws_marketplace_steps.pdf (PDF)

If Acme is comfortable with the liability cap ask, we can send for signature and target completion by 4/23–4/24. Otherwise, we should plan a quick leadership call to approve the exception.

Karthik
Legal & Contracts (Redwood)

----

From: Tom Wu <tom.wu@acme-tech.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@resellera.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-23T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Marketplace close playbook & reseller steps

Thanks team — Procurement checked with finance and they prefer Redwood as merchant-of-record for AWS, but for GCP they need Resellera to be merchant. On the liability cap request: procurement suggests we split the difference and propose $750k. I'll confirm formally by EOD 4/24.

Tom
Head of Procurement, Acme Tech

----

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Tom Wu <tom.wu@acme-tech.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@resellera.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-24T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Marketplace close playbook & reseller steps — final sync

Thanks everyone — quick roundup and action items after procurement's note.

Meeting notes / decisions:
- Reseller GUID: RSR-987654 (confirmed by Resellera).
- Merchant of record: Redwood for AWS; Resellera for GCP. Alyssa/Resellera to confirm invoicing cadence for GCP.
- Liability cap: propose $750k (split-the-difference). Karthik to send updated redline to Acme legal; target response by 4/26.
- DocuSign envelope: draft ready. Karthik to send for signature once liability cap is confirmed.

Action items (owners, due dates):
1) Alicia / Resellera — Provide GCP invoicing/tax details + confirm merchant-of-record flow for GCP (due 2027-04-26)
2) Karthik Iyer — Update contract redline to $750k, share with Acme legal, and prepare DocuSign send (due 2027-04-26)
3) Marissa Cole — Run the tech kickoff on 4/26 2:00–3:00 PM PT; circulate agenda and pre-read (due 2027-04-25)
4) Dylan Brooks — Follow up with Acme exec sponsor on Friday for final approval and notify CS of expected close date (due 2027-04-27)
5) Vanessa Ortiz — Coordinate billing ops runbook and SKU mapping template with Acme finance (attach SKU mapping in MAP) (due 2027-04-28)

Attachments included in thread: acme_map_v3.xlsx, aws_marketplace_steps.pdf, resellera_onboarding_packet.pdf
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/DEAL-2027-ACME-17, https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123

If there are no objections, I'll mark the MAP status as "Ready for signature" and ask Karthik to send the DocuSign package tomorrow.

Best,
Dylan
Enterprise Lead, US West
Redwood Inference
